def find_years(n, abbreviations):
    used_years = set()
    years = []
    
    for abbr in abbreviations:
        y = abbr[4:]
        length = len(y)
        
        # Start checking from the earliest possible year
        for year in range(1989, 10000):
            if str(year)[-length:] == y and year not in used_years:
                used_years.add(year)
                years.append(year)
                break
    
    return years
